name: novel-architect
description: A write-review-correct-verify workshop for the Starfire historical time-travel novel: a lead editor orchestrates plot, protocolology sentinel, timeline auditor and prose editor into one gated chain, preventing history-gravity drift, canon amnesia and AI-flavored prose.

profession.zh: 星火小说写审纠核工坊

displayDescription.en: Five-role workshop: plot, protocolology guard, timeline causality and prose quality, gated by sp-novel-engine.
displayDescription.zh: 五人工坊：情节、协议学哨兵、时间线因果、文笔质检，sp-novel-engine 过闸。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按《星火》大纲推进下一章：先做时间线与协议学预审，再出章节细纲与正文，最后跑 Check-1..10 门禁。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Advance the next chapter of Starfire from its outline: pre-check timeline and protocolology, draft the beat sheet and prose, then run the Check-1..10 gate.

quickPrompts.zh: 按《星火》大纲推进下一章：先做时间线与协议学预审，再出章节细纲与正文，最后跑 Check-1..10 门禁。
quickPrompts.en: Advance the next chapter of Starfire from its outline: pre-check timeline and protocolology, draft the beat sheet and prose, then run the Check-1..10 gate.

quickPrompts.zh: 用哨兵视角审这一章：林枫有没有沦为历史旁观者、先知剧透日期或滑向军阀文？给出阻断理由。
quickPrompts.en: Review this chapter as the protocolology sentinel: has Lin Feng become a bystander, spoiled historical dates, or drifted into warlord fiction? Give blocking reasons.

quickPrompts.zh: 按司历规则核这段蝴蝶效应：历史 NPC 有没有按原剧本梦游，人物弧光是否连续？
quickPrompts.en: Audit this butterfly-effect segment as the timeline auditor: are historical NPCs sleepwalking the real script, and are character arcs continuous?
